objections: NVIDIA: Definition is incorrect. Sunrise period is a pre-launch phase for trademark holders to register domain names, not an opposition period.

Google: In trademark/domain law, a sunrise period refers to the time-frame before general domain name registration opens when trademark owners can register corresponding domain names, not 'पंजीकरण से पहले का विरोध अवधि' (pre-registration opposition period).
